title: A Complete Characterization of Learnability for Adversarial Noisy Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2605.09200v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study adversarial noisy bandits given a known function class $\mathcal{F}$. In each round, the adversary selects a function $f \in \mathcal{F}$, the learner chooses an arm, and then observes a noisy reward determined by the chosen arm and the function $f$. The goal is to minimize the cumulative regret $R(T)$, defined as the difference between the learner's performance and that of the best fixed arm in hindsight over $T$ rounds. We say that a function class $\mathcal{F}$ is learnable if there exists an algorithm achieving sublinear regret. Our main result is a complete characterization of learnability for adversarial noisy bandits. The characterization is given in terms of a convexified variant of the generalized maximin volume introduced by Hanneke and Wang (2025): namely, the generalized maximin volume evaluated on the convex hull $\operatorname{co}(\mathcal F)$. translated_title: 对抗性噪声老虎机可学习性的完整刻画
translated_abstract: 我们研究在给定已知函数类 $\mathcal{F}$ 条件下的对抗性噪声老虎机问题。在每一轮中，对抗者从 $\mathcal{F}$ 中选择一个函数 $f$，学习者选择一个臂，随后观察到由所选臂和函数 $f$ 共同决定的含噪奖励。目标是最小化累积遗憾 $R(T)$，其定义为学习者在 $T$ 轮内的表现与事后最优固定臂表现之差。若存在能够实现次线性遗憾的算法，我们称函数类 $\mathcal{F}$ 是可学习的。我们的主要结果是对抗性噪声老虎机可学习性的完整刻画。该刻画基于 Hanneke 和 Wang（2025）提出的广义极大极小体积的一种凸化变体，即在函数类凸包 $\operatorname{co}(\mathcal F)$ 上求值的广义极大极小体积。我们证明，$\mathcal{F}$ 是可学习的当且仅当该凸化的……
tldr: 本文通过在函数类凸包上求值的广义极大极小体积这一凸化变体，首次完整刻画了对抗性噪声老虎机中函数类可学习的充要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper gives a complete characterization of learnability for adversarial noisy bandits, showing that a function class is learnable if and only if a convexified variant of the generalized maximin volume, evaluated on the convex hull of the class, satisfies the learnability condition.
